items.text_vn: Cho mình hỏi, mình chưa từng lai thú cưng nhưng nghe nói phải lấy con chính lai với 3 con khác đạt cấp tối đa. Mình mất nhiều kim cương để tăng EXP cả 4 con mà sao không lai được vậy?
items.text_en: Quick question: I've never bred pets, but I heard you need the main pet plus 3 others at max level. I spent a lot of diamonds boosting EXP for all 4, so why can't I breed them?
items.summary_vn: Tốn nhiều kim cương nâng 4 thú cưng nhưng vẫn không lai được.
items.summary_en: Spent many diamonds leveling 4 pets but still can't breed them.
items.theme: Hoạt động và tính năng trong game
items.topic: Activities (fishing, bugs, pets, housing, jobs, minigames)

items.text_th: ใช้ได้กับแค่บางตัวครับ บางตัวต้องเหมือนกันถึงจะผสมกันได้ครับ
items.text_vn: Chỉ áp dụng với một số con thôi ạ, có con phải giống nhau mới lai được.
items.text_en: It only works with some pets; some need to be the same kind to breed.
items.summary_vn: Giải thích chỉ một số thú cưng mới lai khác loại, còn lại phải giống nhau.
items.summary_en: Explains only some pets can mix; others must match.
items.theme: Hoạt động và tính năng trong game
items.topic: Activities (fishing, bugs, pets, housing, jobs, minigames)

items.text_th: ต้องเป็นสัตว์ชนิดเดียวกันค่ะสำหรับ เราคิดว่านะเพราะเราผสมสำเร็จตลอด
items.text_vn: Phải là cùng loài ạ, mình nghĩ vậy vì mình lai thành công suốt.
items.text_en: They must be the same species, I think, because mine always work.
items.summary_vn: Cho rằng phải cùng loài mới lai được.
items.summary_en: Thinks pets must be the same species to breed.
items.theme: Hoạt động và tính năng trong game
items.topic: Activities (fishing, bugs, pets, housing, jobs, minigames)

items.text_th: ลา เป็นตัวพิเศษครับ (ถ้าเป็นม้า ยูนิคอร์น หรือเปกาซัสผสมคละแบบได้) แต่ถ้าเป็นลาต้องใช้ลา ทั้ง 4 ตัวในการผสมครับ
items.text_vn: Con lừa là loại đặc biệt ạ (ngựa, kỳ lân hay Pegasus thì lai lẫn nhau được), còn lừa thì phải dùng đủ 4 con lừa để lai.
items.text_en: The donkey is a special case (horse, unicorn or Pegasus can be mixed), but donkeys need all 4 to be donkeys.
items.summary_vn: Giải thích lừa phải dùng 4 con lừa, ngựa/kỳ lân/Pegasus lai lẫn được.
items.summary_en: Explains donkeys need 4 donkeys; horse, unicorn and Pegasus can mix.
items.theme: Hoạt động và tính năng trong game
items.topic: Activities (fishing, bugs, pets, housing, jobs, minigames)

items.text_th: พึ่งกลับมาเล่นค่ะ หลังจากหายไปเกือบ1-2ปี ไม่รู้เริ่มต้นยังไงดี ตอนนี้ถ้าทำเควสอะไรจะไหมคะ
items.text_vn: Mới quay lại chơi sau gần 1–2 năm nghỉ, không biết bắt đầu thế nào. Bây giờ làm nhiệm vụ gì thì tốt ạ?
items.text_en: I just came back after almost 1–2 years away and don't know where to start. Which quests should I do now?
items.summary_vn: Người chơi quay lại hỏi nên làm nhiệm vụ nào trước.
items.summary_en: A returning player asks which quests to do first.
items.theme: Góp ý trải nghiệm chung

items.text_th: เควสโรงแรมเลยครับทำเอารถทำวันเดียวก็เสร็จแล้วครับกิจนี้ง่าย
items.text_vn: Làm nhiệm vụ khách sạn đi ạ, làm để lấy xe chỉ một ngày là xong, nhiệm vụ này dễ.
items.text_en: Do the hotel quest. You can finish it in a single day to get the vehicle. It's an easy event.
items.summary_vn: Gợi ý làm sự kiện khách sạn vì dễ, một ngày xong.
items.summary_en: Recommends the hotel event: easy and done in one day.
items.theme: Phần thưởng sự kiện

items.text_th: เควสวันนี้ มีใครรู้ที่ขายใบต้นลอเรล กับที่ให้ตกปลาบอลลูน หน้าตาเป็นไงอ่ะครับ และตกที่ไหน? ขอบคุณครับ
items.text_vn: Nhiệm vụ hôm nay, ai biết chỗ bán lá cây nguyệt quế và con cá balloon trông thế nào, câu ở đâu không ạ? Cảm ơn ạ.
items.text_en: Today's quest: does anyone know where to buy laurel leaves, what the balloon fish looks like, and where to fish for it? Thanks.
items.summary_vn: Hỏi chỗ bán lá nguyệt quế và cách câu cá balloon cho nhiệm vụ.
items.summary_en: Asks where to buy laurel leaves and how to catch the balloon fish for the quest.
items.theme: Phần thưởng sự kiện

items.text_th: ใบลอเรลอยู่ข้างซีอิ๊วเลยครับแถวเดียงกัน
items.text_vn: Lá nguyệt quế nằm ngay cạnh nước tương, cùng một dãy ạ.
items.text_en: Laurel leaves are right next to the soy sauce, same row.
items.summary_vn: Chỉ vị trí lá nguyệt quế cạnh nước tương.
items.summary_en: Points out laurel leaves are next to the soy sauce.
items.theme: Phần thưởng sự kiện

items.text_th: เหยื่อปลาทูทำยังไงคะ มีใครทำแล้วบางคะ
items.text_vn: Mồi cá thu làm sao ạ? Có ai làm rồi chưa?
items.text_en: How do you make the mackerel bait? Has anyone done it yet?
items.summary_vn: Hỏi cách làm mồi cá thu.
items.summary_en: Asks how to make the mackerel bait.
items.theme: Phần thưởng sự kiện

items.text_th: ปลาบอลลูนครับเห็นคนในเกมคุยกันเป็นปลายักษ์ ต้องตกแค่ในวงเท่านั้น
items.text_vn: Cá balloon nghe người trong game nói là cá khổng lồ, chỉ câu được trong vòng (bóng) thôi ạ.
items.text_en: From in-game chat, the balloon fish is a giant fish and can only be caught inside the circle.
items.summary_vn: Cho biết cá balloon là cá khổng lồ chỉ câu được trong vòng bóng.
items.summary_en: Says the balloon fish is a giant fish only catchable inside the shadow circle.
items.theme: Phần thưởng sự kiện
